}}'''Pijin''' is an NPC in [[Huanglong]].
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Pijin:''' All the deliveries for the [[Tiderise Cliff]] have been finished. Are we done today? Well, that's unusual...
:'''Pijin:''' Whoa! I've got another 50 orders from [[Peipei]] just now!
:'''Pijin:''' These ones surely have an overwhelming kick...
:'''Pijin:''' Wait. All of these are sent to [[Taoyuan Vale]], which means we have to pass through the [[Gubei Pass]] again.
:{{DIcon}} Looks she is quite busy. Let's leave her alone.
:'''Pijin:''' I taught a lesson to that annoying [[Shengying]] a few times. Hope he can just stop bothering me.
:'''Pijin:''' Ugh... I can't stand it... But as a navigator, I have to keep my spirits up and work hard, to set a good example for the younger ones!
{{Dialogue End}}
